Every method of `Trawl`, grouped by resource. Types are under the `Trawl` namespace (`import type { Trawl } from "@productcraft/trawl"`). Every method takes per-request options last (`{ idempotencyKey, timeout, maxRetries, headers, signal, workspaceId }`).

## credits

### `trawl.credits.retrieve(options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/credits` → `Trawl.Credits`

Remaining Trawl steps for this workspace, whether the balance is low, and recent ledger entries.

The balance in steps (one agent step uses one credit), whether it is under the low-balance line the `credits.low` webhook uses, and the 50 most recent ledger entries behind it, newest first.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `trawl.read`, or the service is not enabled. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const credits = await trawl.credits.retrieve();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/trawl/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-credits)

## jobs

### `trawl.jobs.cancel(id, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/jobs/{id}/cancel` → `Trawl.Job`

Cancel a queued or running trawl job.

Moves a `queued` or `running` job to `cancelled` straight away. A result the worker reports afterwards is discarded and not charged. Cancelling a job that already ended answers 422.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Job not found in this workspace. |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | Job is already in a terminal state and cannot be cancelled. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const job = await trawl.jobs.cancel("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/trawl/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-jobs-id-cancel)

### `trawl.jobs.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/jobs` → `Trawl.Job`

Create (enqueue) a trawl job.

Queues an extraction: an agent browses from `suggested_urls` (or searches when there are none) and returns JSON matching `json_schema`. The job starts `queued`; poll `GET /jobs/{id}` until `status` is `succeeded`, `failed` or `cancelled`, or subscribe a webhook endpoint to `job.succeeded` / `job.failed`. Each agent step uses one credit; a workspace at zero credits gets 402. Send an `Idempotency-Key` so a retried request never queues a second job.

- Params: `Trawl.JobCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Invalid JSON Schema (must be a non-empty `type: object`). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `trawl.create`, or workspace has not enabled the `trawl` service. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED`, `TOO_MANY_ACTIVE_JOBS` | Rate limited. `RATE_LIMITED` — submission window exceeded (default 10/min per workspace); the `Retry-After` header gives the seconds until the window resets. `TOO_MANY_ACTIVE_JOBS` — too many queued/running jobs (default 25); retry once some finish. Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const job = await trawl.jobs.create({
  description: "Extract the product title and price from each page.",
  json_schema: { properties: { title: { type: "string" } }, required: ["title"], type: "object" },
});
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/trawl/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-jobs)

### `trawl.jobs.list(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/jobs` → `PagePromise<Trawl.Job>`

List trawl jobs (paginated, newest first).

The workspace's jobs, newest first, optionally filtered by `status`. Pass the previous page's `next_cursor` as `cursor` until `has_more` is false.

- Params: `Trawl.JobListParams`
- Paginated: `for await` iterates every item; `await` gives one page

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `trawl.list`, or workspace has not enabled the `trawl` service. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
for await (const job of trawl.jobs.list()) {
  console.log(job);
}
const page = await trawl.jobs.list({}, { timeout: 5_000 });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/trawl/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-jobs)

### `trawl.jobs.retrieve(id, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/jobs/{id}` → `Trawl.Job`

Get a single trawl job.

The job with its current `status`, and `result` (JSON matching the job's `json_schema`) once it has `succeeded` or `error` once it has `failed`. Poll this until `status` is terminal; every read is free.

- Polling: `jobs.poll(…)` waits for `status` ∈ `succeeded`, `failed`, `cancelled`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Job not found in this workspace. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const job = await trawl.jobs.retrieve("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/trawl/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-jobs-id)

## stats

### `trawl.stats.retrieve(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/stats` → `Trawl.TrawlWorkspaceStats`

Trawl stats for a workspace.

Total jobs, jobs created / succeeded / failed and steps used in the window, the credit balance, when the latest job was created and a daily jobs series.

**Active** means a job was created.

Days are UTC. Counts only: no target URLs, descriptions or job results. Cached for up to 60 seconds (`generated_at`).

- Params: `Trawl.StatsRetrieveParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `window` is not one of 1d, 7d, 30d. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `trawl.read` on the workspace, or Trawl is not enabled on it (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found: the id is unknown, is not a UUID, or is not visible to the caller. Same answer as the service's other workspace routes. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const trawlWorkspaceStats = await trawl.stats.retrieve();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/trawl/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-stats)

## webhooks

### `trawl.webhooks.unwrap({ payload, headers, secret? })`

Verifies the signature and returns `Trawl.UnwrapWebhookEvent`. Events: `credits.low`, `job.failed`, `job.succeeded`, plus `UnknownWebhookEvent` for types added later.

### `trawl.webhooks.sign({ payload, secret?, id?, timestamp? })`

Signs a test event exactly as ProductCraft signs deliveries (Standard Webhooks) and returns `{ payload, headers }`, ready for `unwrap` or a request to your handler. For tests; real deliveries come signed.

## webhooks.endpoints

### `trawl.webhooks.endpoints.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/endpoints` → `Trawl.WebhookEndpointWithSecret`

Add a webhook endpoint. Returns its signing secret once.

Deliveries are signed with the Standard Webhooks headers `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp` and `webhook-signature` (`v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256 of "<id>.<timestamp>.<body>">`); the returned `whsec_…` secret works unchanged with any Standard Webhooks library. Failed deliveries are retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h and 24 h.

- Params: `Trawl.WebhookEndpointCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN` | Validation failure: URL not https with a public host, or an unknown event type (`WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `trawl.webhook.read` (reads) or `trawl.webhook.manage` (changes, Send test, replay), or Trawl is not enabled for the workspace (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Already 10 endpoints (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT`), or Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | The URL points at a private, loopback or internal address. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEndpoint = await trawl.webhooks.endpoints.create({ url: "https://api.acme.com/webhooks" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/trawl/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-webhooks-endpoints)

| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |


### `trawl.webhooks.endpoints.rotateSecret(endpointId, params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/endpoints/{endpoint_id}/rotate-secret` → `Trawl.WebhookEndpointWithSecret`

Rotate the signing secret. The new one is returned once.

For `grace_hours` (default 24) the previous secret keeps signing too: `webhook-signature` then lists one `v1,` signature per secret, so receivers can switch over without dropping a delivery.

- Params: `Trawl.WebhookEndpointRotateSecretParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `grace_hours` out of range, or `endpoint_id` is not a UUID. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `trawl.webhook.read` (reads) or `trawl.webhook.manage` (changes, Send test, replay), or Trawl is not enabled for the workspace (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | No such endpoint here (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEndpoint = await trawl.webhooks.endpoints.rotateSecret("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { grace_hours: 24 });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/trawl/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-webhooks-endpoints-endpoint-id-rotate-secret)

### `trawl.webhooks.endpoints.test(endpointId, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/endpoints/{endpoint_id}/test` → `Trawl.WebhookDeliveryAttempt`

Send a test event to this endpoint now and return the result.

Delivers the catalogue example of `event_type`, signed like any delivery, with `"test": true` in the body. Works while the endpoint is switched off or not subscribed to that type, is logged in the event log, and is never retried or counted toward an automatic disable. Waits up to 15 s for your receiver.

- Params: `Trawl.WebhookEndpointTestParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Unknown `event_type`, or `endpoint_id` is not a UUID. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `trawl.webhook.read` (reads) or `trawl.webhook.manage` (changes, Send test, replay), or Trawl is not enabled for the workspace (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | No such endpoint here (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookDeliveryAttempt = await trawl.webhooks.endpoints.test("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { event_type: "job.succeeded" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/trawl/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-webhooks-endpoints-endpoint-id-test)

### `trawl.webhooks.endpoints.update(endpointId, params?, options?)`

`PATCH /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/endpoints/{endpoint_id}` → `Trawl.WebhookEndpoint`

Change a webhook endpoint: URL, description, events, on/off.

Only the fields sent change. `enabled: true` (or a new URL) also clears an automatic disable. Switching off cancels queued retries. The secret is unchanged; rotate it with `POST …/rotate-secret`.

- Params: `Trawl.WebhookEndpointUpdateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failure, or `endpoint_id` is not a UUID. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `trawl.webhook.read` (reads) or `trawl.webhook.manage` (changes, Send test, replay), or Trawl is not enabled for the workspace (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | No such endpoint here (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | The new URL points at a private, loopback or internal address. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEndpoint = await trawl.webhooks.endpoints.update("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { description: "Production receiver" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/trawl/api-reference#patch-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-webhooks-endpoints-endpoint-id)

### `trawl.webhooks.events.replay(eventId, params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/events/{event_id}/replay` → `Trawl.ReplayWebhookEvent`

Send a logged event again, to its endpoints or to one endpoint.

Same body and `webhook-id`, freshly signed, to every switched-on endpoint that receives this event type now, or only to `endpoint_id`. Waits for the receivers (up to 15 s each) and returns the attempts. A success cancels a retry still queued for that endpoint.

- Params: `Trawl.WebhookEventReplayParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `event_id` is not `evt_<uuid>`, or `endpoint_id` is not a UUID. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `trawl.webhook.read` (reads) or `trawl.webhook.manage` (changes, Send test, replay), or Trawl is not enabled for the workspace (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | No such event here (`WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND`); events are kept for 30 days. Or No such endpoint here (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_SUBSCRIBED`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `endpoint_id` is switched off or does not receive this event type (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_SUBSCRIBED`), or Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const replayWebhookEvent = await trawl.webhooks.events.replay("evt_3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/trawl/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-webhooks-events-event-id-replay)

### `trawl.webhooks.events.retrieve(eventId, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/events/{event_id}` → `Trawl.WebhookEventDetail`

Get one webhook event with every delivery attempt.

The event as it was sent (`type`, `data`) and every delivery attempt to every endpoint, with its trigger, HTTP status, error and the start of the response body. Use it to debug a receiver, then `replay` to send it again.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `event_id` is not `evt_<uuid>`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `trawl.webhook.read` (reads) or `trawl.webhook.manage` (changes, Send test, replay), or Trawl is not enabled for the workspace (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND` | No such event here (`WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND`); events are kept for 30 days. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEventDetail = await trawl.webhooks.events.retrieve("evt_3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/trawl/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-webhooks-events-event-id)

## Error codes

`err.code` on an `APIError` is one of these (an open set: new codes may appear).

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `BAD_REQUEST` | The request is malformed (not valid JSON, a bad header, an unusable parameter). |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | One or more request fields are invalid; `errors` lists each field (`param`, `message`, `code`). |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | No credentials, or the token or API key is invalid, expired or revoked. |
| `PAYMENT_REQUIRED` | The workspace has no credit or plan for this operation. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | The caller is authenticated but not allowed to do this. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | The resource does not exist, or belongs to another workspace or app. |
| `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` | The route does not accept this HTTP method. |
| `NOT_ACCEPTABLE` | The route cannot produce the requested content type. |
| `REQUEST_TIMEOUT` | The request took too long to arrive. |
| `CONFLICT` | The request conflicts with the current state of the resource. |
| `GONE` | The resource existed but has been removed for good. |
| `PRECONDITION_FAILED` | A precondition header did not match. |
| `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | The request body is over the size limit. |
| `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | The request body is not in a content type the route accepts. |
| `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | The request is well-formed but cannot be carried out. |
| `PRECONDITION_REQUIRED` | The route requires a precondition header. |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | Too many requests; retry after the `Retry-After` header. |
| `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` | An unexpected server error. Retrying is safe for idempotent requests; quote `request_id` to support. |
| `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` | The server does not support this operation. |
| `BAD_GATEWAY` | An upstream service returned an invalid response. |
| `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | The service or one of its dependencies is temporarily unavailable; retry. |
| `GATEWAY_TIMEOUT` | An upstream service did not answer in time; retry. |
| `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The workspace has not enabled this product. |
| `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` | The credentials were not accepted. |
| `SESSION_REVOKED` | The session behind this token was signed out or revoked. |
| `MCP_NOT_PERMITTED` | An MCP (agent) token cannot call this route. |
| `MCP_WORKSPACE_MISMATCH` | The MCP token was issued for a different workspace. |
| `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED` | A workspace API key cannot call this route. |
| `ACTIONS_NOT_GRANTABLE` | The policy grants actions the caller does not hold. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` | The `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED` | This operation requires an `Idempotency-Key` header. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | A request with the same `Idempotency-Key` is still running. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds with the same key to get its response. |
| `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT` | The workspace has the maximum number of webhook endpoints. |
| `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | No webhook endpoint with this id in this workspace. |
| `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_SUBSCRIBED` | The endpoint is not subscribed to this event type. |
| `WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND` | No webhook event with this id in this workspace. |
| `WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN` | The event type is not one this product sends. |
| `TOO_MANY_ACTIVE_JOBS` | The workspace has the maximum number of active jobs; wait or cancel some. |
| `TRAWL_CREDITS_EXHAUSTED` | The workspace has no Trawl credits left. |
